name: openmanager
description: Desktop GUI for managing OpenCode agent sessions

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentpack/contract typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentpack/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentpack/view typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/convex typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/web typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol lint && pnpm --filter @openmanager/desktop lint && pnpm --filter @openmanager/server lint && pnpm --filter @openmanager/web lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol test && pnpm --filter @openmanager/desktop test && pnpm --filter @openmanager/server test && pnpm --filter @openmanager/web test
scripts.ci: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.ci:protocol: pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol build && pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol lint && pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol test
scripts.ci:desktop: pnpm --filter @openmanager/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/desktop lint && pnpm --filter @openmanager/desktop test
scripts.ci:server: pnpm --filter @openmanager/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/server lint && pnpm --filter @openmanager/server test && pnpm --filter @openmanager/server build
scripts.ci:web: pnpm --filter @openmanager/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @openmanager/web lint && pnpm --filter @openmanager/web test && pnpm --filter @openmanager/web build
